title: 2x Tinantia Pringlei - Mini Plug Plant Houseplant - Rare Unusual Plant
description:
Unusual, high-altitude Mexican Tradescantia relative with striking purple/brown-marked leaves. Produces violet flowers over a very long season (summer to autumn). Deciduous, fast-spreading from a perennial base to form a wide mat in a single season. Self-seeds lightly.


 Key Features:


  Habit: Groundcover, mat-forming; deciduous
 

  Foliage: Purple/brown marked
 

  Flowers: Violet, very long blooming season
 

  Growth: Spreads rapidly each season; gently self-seeds
 

  Hardiness: Proven hardy to approximately -14°C (survived 2009/2010 UK winters)
 

  Soil: Well-drained; tolerates light soils, clay, and chalky clay
 

  Sun/Shade: Sun for compact, bright color and more flowers; shade + water for lusher, greener growth
 

  Drought: Tolerant; not fussy about conditions
 

  Maintenance: If straggly by mid-summer, shear back like hardy geraniums
 

  Pests/Diseases: Rarely troubled; none observed in long-term growing
 

 Care:


  Position: Full sun to partial shade
 

  Water: Moderate; more water in shade for lush growth
 

  Notes: Completely dies back in winter; regrows from the base in spring
